visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a top-knot bun hairstyle and shaved sides sits indoors, intently gazing at a black smartphone held in both hands. He wears a white T-shirt with small black printed text. The background features a wooden door and a beige wall under bright indoor lighting. (2) The screen switches to first-person gameplay footage of a military shooter. Two soldiers in green tactical gear move across a metal platform. A massive explosion erupts on the left side, scattering orange sparks and grey smoke across the frame. (3) The camera returns to the man, who now displays a wide-eyed, shocked facial expression. He looks around the room quickly, revealing a red and black gaming chair with a blue headrest behind him. His mouth is slightly open in a gasp. (4) A rapid montage sequence begins, showing the man green-screened into various combat environments. He wears a red beret and a white tank top, pointing his fingers and gesturing aggressively while his mouth moves as if yelling. Digital text overlays and game logos appear frequently. (5) Back in the room, the man stands in front of a white refrigerator with a bewildered look. A digital black smoke overlay billows in the foreground, partially masking his face. He holds the phone up, looking at it with intense concentration. (6) The video concludes with an extreme close-up of the man's face. He stares directly into the lens with a strained, squinting expression, his facial features highly detailed. He eventually holds the smartphone up to the camera, showing a game interface with a large green button.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A male with a distinctive top-knot bun hairstyle, shaved sides, and a goatee, wearing a white T-shirt and occasionally a red beret in edited segments.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Initially a domestic indoor room with a gaming chair, wooden door, and refrigerator; later transitions into digitally rendered war zones including industrial decks and desert ruins.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with low-arousal ambient room tone and soft, metallic clicks of fingers interacting with a glass phone screen. There is no music or speech, emphasizing a quiet, focused domestic atmosphere. (2) A sudden explosion of sound occurs, featuring sharp, high-intensity gunfire transients and deep, resonant explosions with wide spectral frequency. A male voice shouts 'Hah!' and reacts with frantic, high-arousal exclamations. (3) High-energy cinematic music with a driving electronic beat and orchestral brass swells in. The male speaker delivers authoritative, gravelly vocal commands with high tension. Frequent 'whoosh' sound effects and weapon-related foley underscore the fast-paced editing. (4) The music shifts to a subtle but tense electronic bed. The male speaker's voice moves into an extreme close-mic position, becoming deep, raspy, and filled with audible breathiness. The pace slows, ending with a soft digital UI chime and heavy breathing.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Immersion -> Feature Highlight -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the mobile game 'Delta Force' (三角洲行動) by leveraging an influencer's high-energy reaction and immersive roleplay, highlighting the 24v24 gameplay feature and encouraging immediate downloads.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of game logo, gameplay footage, and a call to action asking viewers to download.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High production value advertisement featuring social media influencer ironbullim. The edit effectively blends domestic reality with high-octane gaming visuals.
